purpose: Audits a servicer escrow accounting statement from borrower-supplied VALUES ONLY (zero PII by schema): recomputes the aggregate accounting trial running balance month by month from the stated opening balance, stated monthly escrow deposit values, and stated disbursement values, compares the servicer stated end-of-month balances line by line against the recomputation, flags each discrepant statement line with a per-line reason, checks the stated cushion against the one-sixth-of-estimated-total-annual-disbursements cap, and classifies the recomputed account as balanced, shortage, surplus, or deficiency with the corresponding remedy thresholds (50-dollar surplus refund floor conditioned on borrower currency, the courses permitted for a shortage, thresholded on one month's escrow payment). Emits stable scalar evidence fields suitable for anchored-receipt shaping downstream. Declared domain exclusions: no tax-sale scenarios, no escrowed-MSA states, values only -- identifier-like or free-text fields are refused, never echoed, and more than 12 monthly periods is refused.
